# Type S/M Calibrator

Purpose: focused static app for forward selected-claim, Type S, and Type M
calibration under one-parameter Wald models.

Interpretation:
- Every x-axis value is an assumed true effect.
- Outputs are repeated-study operating characteristics, not posterior
  probabilities and not evidence conditional on observed data.
- Type S is conditional wrong-sign probability among selected claims.
- Type M is conditional expected selected magnitude divided by true
  working-scale magnitude.
- Ratio measures use log-scale distance from the null.
- Type S/M and observed exaggeration are null at or near the null; Type S/M
  may also be unavailable when selected-claim probability is numerically zero.
- Observed exaggeration is separate from Type M.

Architecture:
- `wald-inference` 0.3.0 is the only numerical/formula authority and is pinned
  to its official release wheel by URL and SHA-256.
- `src/type_sm_calibrator/` owns validation, orchestration, strict JSON,
  reviewer text, and warnings.
- `web/` owns client-only presentation and exports.
- `web/assets/py/` is generated and ignored.
- There is no backend, persistence, telemetry, cookie, upload, or input-bearing
  URL.

Scenario/export contract:
- Active claim thresholds are rule inputs and plot markers, not automatic
  assumed-truth scenarios.
- Reviewer defaults prioritize user, then non-null reference, then observed
  scenarios; observed-as-truth remains explicitly optimistic/circular.
- The curve CSV has eight stable numeric columns and must travel with the
  caption or focused JSON for rule and conditioning context.
- Plot values above 10x are clipped only for display; standalone PNGs disclose
  clipping and all numeric outputs remain uncapped.

Scope exclusions:
- no inverse precision or exact sample-size solver;
- no observed-data confidence/support panels;
- no posterior probability;
- no clinical validation or clinical guidance.

Key files:
- `README.md`: user and developer front door.
- `docs/SCIENTIFIC_SCOPE.md`: model, six rules, metrics, working scales, and
  limitations.
- `docs/VALIDATION.md`: frozen parity and browser gates.
- `docs/RUNTIME_DEPENDENCIES.md`: core/artifact and license provenance.
- `docs/PRIVACY.md`: client-only data flow.
- `browser-stage.toml`: exact browser package configuration.

Canonical verification:
`uv sync --locked && uv run playwright install chromium webkit && make verify`
